leadIn: After completing this lesson, you will be able to:
objectives: Construct a Vue component that accepts a discriminated union prop
Configure TypeScript interfaces to define a discriminated union type
Implement conditional rendering based on the discriminator property
Bind component data to different UI structures for each union variant
Manipulate component state to switch between discriminated union cases
Initialize component props with different discriminated union values
Render appropriate content by checking the discriminator property
